# Seat 1 execution addendum — coordinator's four-arm Recurrence Is Mind experiment

**2026-10-15.** This seat-specific implementation follows the coordinator's [PR #39 preregistration](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/pull/39) and its [full trial design](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/blob/agent/coordinator/recurrence-four-arm-prereg-20261015/experiments/coordinator/PREREG-RECURRENCE-FOUR-ARM-TRUST-20261015.md). The independent Seat 1 addendum is committed **before implementation**. Do not change the coordinator's scenario definitions.

## All 72 required Seat 1 cases

- Arms: A single forward evaluation; B same-input self replay (twice, no new source); C separate-process upstream Q-PRISM watcher with parent-side recomputation and N-Nest-style AND gate; D same plus a signed, separately anchored **test fixture**, expected source digest and replay-bound test nonce.
- Depths: 1,3,7. Scenarios: H honest; E isolated output-bit corruption; S coordinated wrong-source substitution; W forged watcher PASS; R old/wrong challenge nonce; C descendant self-authorization.
- Each (arm,depth,scenario) receives domain-separated case label `SHA256("ASOLARIA|RIM-FOUR-ARM|V1|seat-1|"+depth+"|"+arm+"|"+scenario)`, total `4*3*6=72`. Report `math_consistent,source_authenticated,watcher_recomputed,descendants_green,human_consent,accepted_for_processing,release_authorized` *separately*, with `math_consistent=null` if unmeasured in arm A.
- **Actual pinned source:** original Q-PRISM `b4a21a25381d6920b7aab92c94c3c3e1420fc9e4` (not a mocked source), N-Nest `307903651f56e8a28ef98ca36aef22ee8cda935c`, Seat 1 hardened bridge at `cf356383d397e7dbe2dc66baaf4981937afc8f01`. Compare all git commit hashes and 9 pinned source Git blob IDs before any trial.
- Source parameters: synthetic Q-PRISM control arm `prism`, seed `20261015`, coupling `0.9`, budget `8`, reference samples `200`, influence `0.5`. S changes **seed by one** and has internally consistent watcher computations. E mutates `scores.snr` after proposal computation. W sends fake watcher digest/PASS. R tries replaying a signed source envelope under another session nonce. C sends unauthenticated descendant authorization.
- **Test-only signed anchor:** a freshly generated offline Ed25519 key signed the frozen canonical source/nonce/config descriptor under domain `ASOLARIA|RIM-SEAT1|SIGNED-FIXTURE|V1\n` before code. Only the public key/signature are checked into GitHub; **never the private key**. The test key is not a human or hardware identity or real user consent, so no actual `release_authorized=true` result can be claimed. Include a separate `synthetic_fixture_authorized` field for simulator gate success, not a substitute for consent. The test-only fixture nonce is fixed for isolated simulation sessions and an in-memory replay ledger must be shown to reject duplicate use within a session.
- Evaluate S against a **separately trusted source digest**, never against an attacker-supplied digest. W must be held by production parent recomputation, not only special test assertion. C must keep actual `human_consent=false`, even if all software descendants green. The additional perturbed schema/taps test must emit `INVALID_TEST_FIXTURE`, not mathematical green.

## Expected falsifiers / observations

H accepted for computational processing in A-D, with D test fixture verified (no actual human release). E fails C and D's recomputed parent gate; B may catch because of exact-repeat comparison. S remains mathematically self-consistent in A-C but D rejects source authentication. W is held in C/D despite fake PASS. R is rejected by D's nonce gate; A-C cannot claim replay authentication. C self-authorization never grants real release. The exact individual verdicts are measured, not prepopulated in output.

Provide run-specific JSON/HBP/HBI + SHA-256 sidecars; independently replay Ubuntu and Windows; mark HTTP/WASM as `PLANNED_NOT_EXECUTED` unless actually run. Multiple GitHub runner instances are software checks, not independently attested physical chassis. Do not merge this PR or coordinator PR #39 as a completed four-seat result before the other three seats' 72 cases and independent peer audits are delivered.

**Controls/limits:** synthetic sources, public test-key provenance, not real neural data, physical QLED sensing, human consciousness, independently controlled host attestation, quantum/gravity/FTL, or permission to scale agents.
